query_description: Il tuo PC risulta obsoleto e fuori garanzia. Ti cambieremo il vecchio PC Service TAG ABC12345 con uno nuovo. Ti abbiamo assegnato il nuovo PC con Service TAG XYZ67890 Provvederemo a spedirti il nuovo PC nella filiale di Torino. Puoi darci conferma della filiale? A breve riceverai due mail: 1)Una relativa alla nuova assegnazione 2)Una relativa alla restituzione del tuo attuale device (da non considerare in caso hai esercitato il diritto di prelazione) Questo ticket verrà aggiornato quando il PC sarà disponibile per il ritiro in filiale. Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. Il vecchio PC viene formattato/riconsegnato all'ufficio IT entro e non oltre 30 giorni dalla data di ritiro del nuovo device. Link utili: - Policy di assegnazione dei dispositivi aziendali [aiuto.it/policy](https://short.link) - Guide IT [help.gft.com](https://short.link) L'IT provvederà alla cancellazione sicura dei tuoi dati ed al ripristino come condizioni di fabbrica del tuo vecchio pc. ------------------------------------------------- Your PC is obsolete and out of warranty. We will change your old device with Service TAG ABC12345 to a new one. We have assigned you the new device with Service TAG XYZ67890 We will send you the new PC to the Turin office. Can you give us the confirmation of the branch? You will receive two emails: 1) Regarding the new PC assigned to you 2) Regarding the return of the old one (Please ignore if you already exercise the redeem old PC) This ticket will be updated when the device can be picked up in the office. We remind you that you can redeem your old PC. To exercise the pre-emption it's sufficient to confirm it in the ticket, after that we will contact you for resetting your old device remotely. If you'll receive an email asking you to return the old one, please ignore it. The price is 60 € for PC and 160 € for MacOS. NOTES: Remember that the pre-emption is valid if: You exercise the redemption of the old device within 7 days from the date of creation of this ticket. The old PC will be reset/returned to the IT office within 30 days from the date you picked up the new device. Useful links: - Device Policy [aiuto.it/policy](https://short.link) - IT Guides: [help.gft.com](https://short.link) The IT will provide for the secure deletion of your data and the restoration of your old PC to factory conditions.

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

- QRT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base QRT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the QRT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from QRT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of QRT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between QRT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a QRT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base QRT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the QRT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed (with special attention to security patches)
- As a holder of LAR

- Whether the access is required for a one-time action/software installation or regularly
- Whether you need short-term or long-term access
- Your GHT employee manager’s full name (L6 or above) for approval

- Computer name (Device Name in Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt)

If this is only for a one-time software installation, please use the **Windows Software Installation – I need software or a license installed on my computer** service instead.

Please note that permanent local administrator access requires a detailed business justification, manager approval, compliance with client requirements, and renewal after 12 months.

Hello,

Since you need administrator rights regularly to upgrade libraries for LendInvest development projects, please submit a **Long-Term Local Administrator Rights** request/form.

Please provide the following information:

- Full name of your GDT manager or approver at level L6 or above. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the applicable client requirements. Permanent local admin access is subject to approval, must only be used for authorized business software, and requires renewal after 12 months.

feedback.answer:
Hello,

Administrative rights must be requested through the **Local Administration Rights (LAR) request form**. Please submit the form with the following information:

- Confirm whether **long-term rights** are required for recurring development activities, or whether temporary rights are sufficient.
- Full name of your manager/project manager at **L6 level or above** for approval. If you are L6 or above, enter yourself as the approver.
- Computer name (Device Name in the Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt).
- Operating system.
- Client and project name.
- Detailed justification and a complete list of the software/actions requiring elevated rights (for example, development tools, runtimes, database tools, environment configuration, and local environment setup).

Please first confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the applicable client/project requirements. Only approved, business-related software may be installed, and you must maintain the security patches for any additionally installed software. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

Once the form is submitted with the required details and approval, Group IT can process the request.

Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Michael Scott (Newark) (X58A)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFT-aB1D2Ef34GH (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
ABC Corp
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
IntelliJ
Java 8
Java 17
postman
soapui
dbeaver
nodejs
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

baseline.answer:

For a one-time installation of development software, please submit the request through **Service: Windows Software Installation – “I need software or a license installed on my computer”** rather than requesting local administrator rights.

If you need to regularly install or run software with elevated privileges, submit an **administrative rights** request instead. Include:

- The complete list of required software and actions
- Your Windows computer name (Device Name in Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt)
- Your client/project
- Business justification
- The full name of your manager or approver at level L6 or above

Please also confirm with your manager that the requested software and administrator access comply with the applicable client requirements.
